snippet.title: Otherside Tapes: Favela | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4977840/Otherside_Tapes_Favela/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
